title: Apache Kafka Operations
description: Production operations dashboard for Apache Kafka 4.x KRaft clusters, covering availability, durability, request performance, consumers, control-plane health, and broker resources.

panels.title: Brokers Online
panels.description: Brokers visible to Kafka Exporter. Compare this with the expected cluster size.

panels.title: Topics
panels.description: Number of selected non-internal topics.

panels.title: Partitions
panels.description: Total partitions across selected topics.

panels.title: Active Controllers
panels.description: Exactly one active KRaft controller is expected.

panels.title: Offline Partitions
panels.description: Partitions without an active leader. Any non-zero value is critical.

panels.title: Under-Replicated
panels.description: Partitions with fewer in-sync replicas than configured replicas.

panels.title: Under Min ISR
panels.description: Partitions already below min.insync.replicas and at risk of rejecting acks=all writes.

panels.title: Consumer Lag
panels.description: Total committed-offset lag for selected groups and topics.

panels.title: Cluster Throughput
panels.description: Aggregate client ingress and egress. Traffic has no universal healthy minimum.

panels.title: Request Mix
panels.description: Top Kafka APIs by request rate. Use this to correlate workload shifts with latency and errors.

panels.title: Data-Safety Signals
panels.description: Offline, under-min-ISR, and under-replicated partitions over time.

panels.title: Leader Distribution
panels.description: Current partition leaders by broker. Large skew can concentrate load and tail latency.

panels.title: Under-Replicated
panels.description: Canonical partition total from Kafka Exporter.

panels.title: At Min ISR
panels.description: Partitions one replica failure away from write unavailability.

panels.title: Under Min ISR
panels.description: Partitions currently below their durability requirement.

panels.title: Offline Replicas
panels.description: Replica assignments unavailable on brokers.

panels.title: Reassigning
panels.description: Leader partitions currently being reassigned.

panels.title: Preferred Imbalance
panels.description: Partitions not led by their preferred replica.

panels.title: ISR Churn
panels.description: ISR shrinks indicate replica loss; expansions indicate recovery. Repeated churn suggests flapping.

panels.title: Under-Replicated Topics
panels.description: Top selected topics with replication risk.

panels.title: Leaders by Broker
panels.description: Leader assignment balance across brokers.

panels.title: Replica Assignments by Broker
panels.description: Broker-local partition assignment count. Values should remain broadly even.

panels.title: Offline Replicas by Broker
panels.description: Locate brokers hosting unavailable replica assignments.

panels.title: Configured vs In-Sync Replicas
panels.description: A widening gap indicates incomplete replica recovery.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: All Kafka network requests per second.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Kafka response errors excluding error=NONE.

panels.title: Request Queue
panels.description: Largest broker request queue. Sustained growth indicates saturation.

panels.title: Network Utilization
panels.description: Worst broker network-processor utilization. Kafka recommends at least 30% idle capacity.

panels.title: API Request Rate
panels.description: Top APIs by request rate.

panels.title: API Error Ratio
panels.description: Error responses as a percentage of requests by API. Classify expected transient codes before paging.

panels.title: P99 Request Latency
panels.description: Worst broker p99 total time for the key client and replication APIs.

panels.title: Produce P99 Latency Breakdown
panels.description: Separates queueing, local processing, follower wait, response queue, and send time.

panels.title: Broker Queues
panels.description: Request and response queue depth by broker.

panels.title: Network Processor Idle Capacity
panels.description: Idle fraction by broker. Sustained values below 30% indicate saturation.

panels.title: Total Lag
panels.description: Total selected consumer backlog in offsets.

panels.title: Consumer Groups
panels.description: Selected groups currently reported by Kafka Exporter.

panels.title: Groups Without Members
panels.description: Reported groups with zero active members. Validate whether each group is expected to run continuously.

panels.title: Largest Backlog
panels.description: Worst selected group/topic backlog.

panels.title: Top Consumer Backlogs
panels.description: Largest group/topic backlogs. Offset lag should be interpreted against each workload SLO.

panels.title: Lag by Topic
panels.description: Aggregate selected consumer lag by topic.

panels.title: Lag Growth
panels.description: Positive values indicate backlog growth; negative values indicate recovery.

panels.title: Consumption Rate
panels.description: Committed-offset progress by group and topic. Resets can briefly produce discontinuities.

panels.title: Hot or Stalled Partitions
panels.description: Top partition-level lags, bounded to 50 rows for safe drilldown.

panels.title: Group Members
panels.description: Active consumer members by group.

panels.title: Active Controller
panels.description: Exactly one controller should be active.

panels.title: Active Brokers
panels.description: Active brokers as observed by the controller quorum.

panels.title: Fenced Brokers
panels.description: Fenced brokers cannot serve normal broker traffic.

panels.title: Metadata Errors
panels.description: Controller metadata processing errors observed in the last hour.

panels.title: Quorum Voters
panels.description: Configured KRaft voters reported by quorum nodes.

panels.title: Unknown Voters
panels.description: Unknown voter connections should remain zero.

panels.title: Quorum Leader Agreement
panels.description: Current leader ID reported by every quorum node. -1 or disagreement indicates control-plane instability.

panels.title: KRaft Commit Latency
panels.description: Maximum metadata quorum commit latency by node.

panels.title: Metadata Log Progress
panels.description: High watermark and log-end offset by quorum member.

panels.title: Metadata Application Lag
panels.description: Controller and broker delay applying committed metadata records.

panels.title: Metadata Record Activity
panels.description: KRaft metadata records appended and fetched per second.

panels.title: Offline Log Dirs
panels.description: Offline Kafka log directories. Any non-zero value is critical.

panels.title: Resident Memory
panels.description: Total resident memory across broker JVM processes.

panels.title: CPU Cores
panels.description: CPU cores currently consumed by broker JVM processes.

panels.title: Max FD Utilization
panels.description: Highest broker file-descriptor usage relative to its process limit.

panels.title: GC Duty
panels.description: Fraction of wall time spent in garbage collection across broker JVMs.

panels.title: Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Total open file descriptors across broker JVM processes.

panels.title: CPU by Broker
panels.description: Broker JVM CPU consumption in cores.

panels.title: Resident Memory by Broker
panels.description: Broker JVM resident memory.

panels.title: GC Collection Rate
panels.description: Garbage-collection events per second by broker and collector.

panels.title: File Descriptor Utilization
panels.description: Process file-descriptor pressure by broker. Investigate sustained values above 80%.

panels.title: JVM Garbage Collection
panels.description: Time spent in garbage collection by broker and collector.

panels.title: Virtual Memory by Broker
panels.description: Broker JVM virtual memory footprint; use resident memory for physical pressure.
